acceptanceCriteria: `corvint how` (and MCP) resolves a plain-language goal to: goal screen/outcome, required preconditions with setup records, a step path through the screen graph using learned steps/page-object methods, and an assertion oracle, each element citing evidence.
Ambiguous or unsupported goals return ranked candidates or an abstention naming the missing knowledge (no route, no setup for P, no oracle), never an invented path.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. No how-to verb exists; AMSP term matching is the closest.
title: Site knowledge 6: 'how do I X' task query - goal screen, precondition setup, step path and outcome oracle
